who: Runs the finances of three small companies, one day a week each, and is building a house with a sister. An agent does the first draft of every forecast.

moments.plot: Year-end close for the design agency, a forecast for the brewery, and the builder wants a decision on windows.

tasks.title: List the accruals for the agency
tasks.notes: December rent, the two freelancers, and the conference they already booked.

tasks.title: Match the last bank statements
tasks.notes: Arjun sent the November statements twice. Use the second set.

tasks.title: Agree the close calendar with Arjun
Ask the brewery for their keg counts
Three scenarios for the brewery forecast
Send my hours to the three clients
Choose the window frames with Lena

capture.title: Remind Arjun about the petty cash

file.title: Ask the builder about the deposit date
file.notes: Lena thinks it is due on signing. The contract says first delivery.

dated.title: Draft accounts to the agency board
dated.notes: Accounts, the two open questions, and a one-page summary.

repeating.title: Cash report for the brewery
repeating.notes: Bank, what is owed, payroll in two weeks.

attachments.notes: Last year’s pack as the template. The auditor asked for the lease this time.

tasks.title: Site visit with Lena and the builder

agent.title: Draft the brewery’s three forecasts
agent.notes: Last year’s sales by month, the new taproom, and the price rise in March. One page for each forecast.
agent.question: What should the low case assume?
bodies: The low case opens the taproom in June instead of March. Cash stays positive, but only just in May.
The low case loses one pub in ten after the price rise. Cash stays positive, and the taproom covers most of the gap by summer.
agent.otherBody: Three forecasts, one page each. The low case your way: {answer}
agent.acceptance: The brewery has a low, a middle and a high case.

discuss.title: Answer Lena about the window budget
discuss.notes: She wants the wooden frames. They cost a third more than we planned.
discuss.question: What do you want to suggest?
bodies: Wooden frames at the front, where people see them, and the plain ones at the back. That keeps us inside the budget.
Wooden frames all round, and we leave the shutters for next year. It comes to the same total.
discuss.otherBody: Here is what I think we can do: {answer}
discuss.otherAnswer: Ask the builder for a second price
discuss.handoff: Your next step: send it to Lena tonight
discuss.acceptance: Lena and I agree on the frames.

review.title: Draft the brewery’s three forecasts
review.note: Three cases in the same layout. The price rise is in all three.

review.title: Match the agency’s card spend
review.note: 212 lines. Nine have no receipt yet.

faded: Write a month-end guide for clients
